title: Classical repertoire she plays
summary: She did not play classics with the band but plays them alone for a dance review, including Chopin, Bach and Rachmaninoff.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: What were some of the classics that you played yourself, either alone or with the band?
Well with the band I didn't play classics. But alone I played all of the classics because I played for a dance review. I still play for this dance review and I have to play all types of music.
Well what are some of the names of them?
stuff because it's in seven sharps.
Mm. And a lot of Chopin's music, and Bach and Rachmaninoff, all of that, especially for this dancer, you've got to play all that type of stuff. Mm-hmm.
